2. Daily Summary

Young & Sons Drywall crews continued work at the Cristo Rey Jesuit STEAM Building under Foreman Antonio Rodriguez. Housekeeping was kept up throughout the day: workers removed trash out of the building, cleaners used the trash buggy to haul debris and throw it into the dumpster, and floors were swept. A framer installed wood blocking between the frames, and the laser level in use was inspected with no modifications seen. Hangers cut and installed sheetrock, and finishers continued their work; one worker was about to use stilts, and I saw no modifications on the stilts. Workers and finishers were in full PPE during work hours. Scaffold parts were found left on the second floor. The blue mason scaffold was worked on today: it was too high for the finishers to push it next to the wall, so one section was removed and 3 ft poles were installed on all 4 corners. Tube-lock poles were used as guardrails with 90-degree clamps, due to a shortage of materials at the warehouse. I also inspected a defective MEC 1330SE scissor lift: it shows a code for a defective tilt sensor. The lift goes up about 2 feet, then the alarm goes off and the lift stops.
